```{r}
mpa_effects_by_habitat <- data %>% 
  select(habitat_type, habitat_subtype, climate_effect, mpa_effect) %>% 
  #remove NAs
  filter(!mpa_effect == "not_assessed") %>% 
  filter(!habitat_subtype == "na") %>% 
  filter(!habitat_type == "na") %>% 
  #count by category
  group_by(habitat_type, habitat_subtype) %>% 
  count(mpa_effect) %>% 
  mutate(proportion = n /sum(n))

figure_6 <- ggplot(data = mpa_effects_by_habitat, aes(fill = mpa_effect, y = n, x = habitat_subtype)) + 
  facet_wrap(habitat_type~.) +
  geom_bar(position = 'stack', stat = 'identity') + 
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    fill = "MPA Effect",
    y = "Number of Occurrences",
    x = "Habitat Type"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mpa_colors,
                    labels = c("no_effect" = "No effect",
                              "positive_ecosystem" = "Ecosystem (+)", 
                              "negative_ecosystem" = "Ecosystem (-)",
                              "positive_population" = "Population (+)", 
                              "negative_population" = "Population (-)"),
                    breaks = c("no_effect", "positive_ecosystem", "positive_population", "negative_ecosystem", "negative_population")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels= c("coral_reef" = "Coral reef",
                             "deep_reef" = "Deep reef",
                             "intertidal" = "Intertidal",
                             "kelp_forest" = "Kelp forest",
                             "rocky_reef" = "Rocky reef",
                             "seagrass" = "Seagrass",
                             "shallow_reef" = "Shallow Reef"))

figure_6
```
